missions.teaser: Someone might love hearing from you today.
missions.title: Mission: reach out
missions.body: Think of one person you genuinely miss. Send them a short message — not a meme, not a link. Just you, checking in.

missions.teaser: Your voice counts more than a tap.
missions.title: Mission: use your voice
missions.body: Call someone you usually only text. It can be two minutes. Ask how they are and really listen.

missions.title: Mission: notice the outside
missions.body: Go to a window or step outside for 30 seconds. Name one thing you never really noticed before — a sound, a shape, a color.

missions.title: Mission: connect with the living world
missions.body: Find a plant, a tree, grass, or a pet. Touch it gently. Take one slow breath while you do.

missions.title: Mission: ask something new
missions.body: Ask someone a real question you’ve never asked them before — about their day, a memory, or what they’re excited about. Stay curious, not clever.

missions.title: Mission: a tiny discovery
missions.body: Learn one new fact without opening a feed — read a page of a book, a sign on the street, or ask a human. One fact. That’s enough.

missions.teaser: Change the route. Change the day.
missions.title: Mission: take a different path
missions.body: On your next walk or commute, take one different turn — even a small one. Pay attention to what’s different.

missions.teaser: Make something small, just for you.
missions.title: Mission: a 5-minute creation
missions.body: For five minutes, make something with your hands — doodle, fold paper, hum a melody, rearrange a corner of your space. No posting required.

missions.title: Mission: give your brain quiet
missions.body: Sit or stand still for two minutes without a podcast, video, or feed. Hear the room. Let your mind drift without grabbing new input.

missions.title: Mission: micro-practice
missions.body: Pick something you’ve wanted to learn. Do exactly one tiny practice — one chord, one sentence, one stretch, one line read aloud. Stop after that one step.
